subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5 = 5 Computer is a fairly recent (a) ----- (invent) ----- of modern science. Now it has become an integral part of our life. Computer can help us in many ways and it has relieved us of the monotony of our regular jobs. It can perform (b) ----- (calculate) ----- very quickly. It can also ensure accuracy in its work. Computer has (c) ----- (moved) ----- the burden of our work. In fact, computer has almost become a substitute for human brain. As a result, many people call computer an (d) ----- (electron) ----- brain though it is unable to think (e) ----- (dependent) -----.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) invention; (b) calculation; (c) removed; (d) electronic; (e) independently.
